# Split Payment

Split Payment is documented as separate operations:

- [Create split payment](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/split-payment/create)
- [Get split payment status](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/split-payment/status)

## Notes (extraction)
- The EN, RU and UZ `.html` URLs serve this content with HTTP 200. The extensionless URLs redirect to directory URLs that returned HTTP 404 during verification. Overview links point to the respective locale’s endpoint pages.
- EN, RU and UZ agree on the operations and link targets; labels and introductory prose are translated.
